scope: Proposition 12.9 (Stopped partial-observation estimate) of the manuscript “Random coordinate frames and partial permutation laws” (preprints/Random-coordinate-frames-and-partial-permutation-laws-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0a520da2d4a92a17), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 45. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let d ≥ 4. Put b = 16, m = n/b, q = n − m, and T = (2 + 20b)d = 322d. For every fixed ordered list of q distinct input positions, its image under the physical shuffle at time T has distance at most δd = 4T m + 1 2 n3/2 (1 − 1/(4b))(T−2d+1)/2 = o(1) (12.9) from a uniform injection, uniformly over the chosen list.
